title: CLUES-WEASEL: No additional clues required to choose your time series clustering algorithm
abstract: arXiv:2609.07606v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Time series data is very common in many real-world applications and in numerous domains, with increasing interest for automated information extraction using machine learning. One of these subfields is time series clustering, which consists in identifying clusters among a set of time series in an unsupervised fashion. Most time series clustering algorithms suffer from the same balancing act: they trade clustering performance for faster runtimes or vice versa. We present a novel time series clustering algorithm that we call CLUES-WEASEL, which stands for CLustering with the UnsupervisEd Second version of Word ExtrAction for time SEries cLassification. translated_title: CLUES-WEASEL：无需额外线索即可选择你的时间序列聚类算法
translated_abstract: 时间序列数据在许多现实世界应用和众多领域中非常常见，人们对于使用机器学习进行自动化信息提取的兴趣日益增长。时间序列聚类是其中一个子领域，其目标是以无监督的方式在一组时间序列中识别出聚类。大多数时间序列聚类算法都面临同样的平衡困境：它们要么以聚类性能换取更快的运行速度，要么以运行速度换取更好的聚类性能。我们提出了一种新颖的时间序列聚类算法，称为CLUES-WEASEL，全称为“基于无监督第二版词提取的时序分类聚类算法”。CLUES-WEASEL使用WEASEL 2.0（一种时间序列分类算法）变换步骤的无监督版本来提取特征，然后利用主成分分析对这些特征进行降维，最后使用这些降维后的特征通过k-means算法执行聚类。
tldr: 提出了CLUES-WEASEL，一种结合WEASEL 2.0无监督特征提取、主成分分析降维和k-means聚类的新颖时间序列聚类算法，在聚类性能与运行效率之间实现了良好平衡。
